title: Checks that run only at merge run before the batch's CI, so a lane that would fail them is refused first
why:
A debt's Retire check that runs the whole hooks/test_guard.py can never pass the merge tool's 600 s limit. The refusal shows only at merge, after a full green CI run, so the batch drops late.
